references.title: en.wiktionary: sonst
references.supports: From MHG sunst, OHG sus, inherited; no German surface split

notes.rationale: otherwise, DWDS's sense 3 'im anderen Falle' (the record has no sentence): the control, which no dictionary splits, though its letters open with so. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, and indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root sonst alone.
